title: KCP event_payload result (DESIGN.md §11.3, §11.4, §11.6.1 read family)
description: CommandResult.result payload for event_payload (§11.2 ok arm; the envelope's revision/event_cursor members live outside this payload). Derived payload projection (gap note KG28): the §11.3 envelope's payload members restated for one event — { event_id, schema_ref, payload_digest, payload }.

payload.description: The stored payload, validated by the schema at schema_ref (§11.3); any JSON value here. Registered application event payloads are capped at 64 KiB (§11.8), enforced at admission.

digestHex.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 value of a §11.8 typed digest; the digest type/domain is fixed by the schema field holding it (§11.8: a bare 32-byte value cannot be substituted across digest fields).

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).
